mapper.select: /*获取最新的留痕表信息*/ with TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM( select sys_data_process_mark.*,rank() over(partition by workflow_id order by HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_data_process_mark where page_id in ('ValManualVoucher003') ) WHERE rank = 1 ) select nvl(fp.FINPROD_ID,ftp.finprod_id) finprodId, nvl(fp.finprod_name,fp.finprod_abbr) finprodName, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, a.tradeId, launchUser, nextUser, createTaskTime, instCode from( select replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"booksetId":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"booksetId":"',''),'"','') booksetId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"seqno":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"seqno":"',''),'"','') tradeId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"busiId":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"busiId":"',''),'"','') busiId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"busiName":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"busiName":"',''),'"','') busiName, to_number(replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"bookDate":[^,]+,',1,1)),'"bookDate":',''),',','')) bookDate, T.create_user as launchUser, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN TEMP on T.seq_no = temp.workflow_id and T.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code )A left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on 'F16_'||pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = a.booksetId or pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = a.booksetId left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.finprod_id = a.busiId or fp.finprod_market_id = a.busiId left join fin_trade_product ftp on ftp.finprod_id = a.busiId where a.bookDate/ (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) +TO_DATE('1970-01-01 08:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS')<#{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}+1
